verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents its own threshold-based automation. Scores drive auto-decisioning with thresholds tunable per segment, geography or product line, and ongoing monitoring auto-flags a case for review when its risk score crosses a configured threshold. This is a narrow, compliance-specific form of rule-triggered action rather than a general event→action rule engine, and the evidence comes only from marketing-level claims. Missing for 10: a general user-defined rule builder for arbitrary events, configurable action types beyond decisioning or flagging (e.g., routing rules, notifications), detailed rule-configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Scoring drives auto-decisioning, with thresholds tunable per segment, geography, or product line.
Monitoring feeds a live risk score that auto-flags for review when it crosses your threshold.
